message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and my kids were thrilled! They turned it into a mini camping trip right in our living room, complete with flashlights and snacks. I was a bit frazzled trying to keep everything running, but their laughter reminded me that even in the dark, we can create our own light. It’s a good idea to keep some power banks handy for our devices, just in case! How do you keep the fun going during unexpected outages?
